notes.title: Patch 1.05.2
notes.content: This patch restores the d3d8.dll file to the game's install directory. If you do not see d3d8.dll in your install folder after downloading this update, please ensure you whitelist this file as an exception in your antivirus software.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Today we’ve released patch 1.05 for BloodRayne: Terminal Cut. In this update:


 Button prompts have been updated to use XInput-style controller button icons in place of the original generic PC text prompts.
 Two textures have been restored to how they originally appeared in the console release of BloodRayne.
 An issue where fog, reflections, and other effects could be prevented from rendering near the left edge of the screen at certain draw distances has been fixed.

notes.title: BloodRayne Terminal Cut Editions Receive Fan Requested Update
notes.content:
BloodRayne fans rejoice! 
Ziggurat is thrilled to announce that we have a new update to both Terminal Cut editions of BloodRayne.

By popular demand, both games now use XInput style button prompts in game while playing with a gamepad, replacing the original generic text button prompts.


Other updates include:

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/0e57364a903c8f532ac01b76dd2e20ebe3d52cfb.png

BloodRayne: Terminal Cut

 Two missing 'uncensored' textures restored that were previously missing
 Culling of reflections/fog improved to prevent unintended drop out at the edge of the screen at certain view distances.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373510

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/42c406fd6791d3f3bf760554e657a061bcc09d00.png

BloodRayne 2: Terminal Cut

 Restored a cutscene of Ephemera confronting Rayne which did not play during the game in previous versions.
 Fixed a bug where a line of dialog spoken by Severin would cause Rayne's mouth to move 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373550

notes.title: Rayne is Back in a Blood Drenched Remaster
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/da287ca8622df960bcce64d43c0b012fe4158fe0.jpg

We are thrilled to announce the remastered, high definition edition of BloodRayne Betrayal: Fresh Bites is coming this summer to PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One X|S, Xbox Series X|S and (for the first time) Nintendo Switch.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/dbc91db05a2f3da1e610d783858f101902896eb2.gif

In development by WayForward, the game’s original creators, this updated version of the hit 2D hack ‘n’ slash platformer will feature all-new voice acting performed by the original BloodRayne cast — featuring Laura Bailey (Rayne) and Troy Baker (Kagan).

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/e2416acdf1e4f777272b42c5c9a088275db8ebe0.gif

Do you prefer to get physical? We have partnered with Limited Run Games to offer an exclusive, multiplatform physical release for PlayStation 4 & 5 and Nintendo Switch later this year.

Wishlist today!

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Today we’ve released patch 1.04 for BloodRayne: Terminal Cut. In this update:

 Textures on mutates and other models have been restored to how they originally appeared in the console release of BloodRayne.
 Japanese is now included as a playable language with fully voiced audio.
 Improvements have been made to the rendering of reflections on water.
 Miscellaneous bug fixes have been made.
Steam Trading Cards have also been added to the game.

notes.title: BloodRayne Receives Final Update Today
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/3c83ee78aeae30f0078bb3d6b89270178e43d688.jpg

Last year we brought Rayne out of the 2000s and into the modern era with the release of Terminal Cut editions of BloodRayne and BloodRayne 2. These editions introduced an enhanced lighting system, improved environment effects, increased resolution and improved rendering among many other improvements. 

Today we are launching a new patch for both Terminal Cut games which we anticipate to be the last significant update for these games. The Ultimate Update includes balance changes, localization improvements and feature upgrades that build upon the impressive Terminal Cut enhancements players already enjoy. 

Now is the perfect time to relive Rayne’s first two adventures, or complete your collection, all three BloodRayne games are 40% off, our lowest price ever! 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/47b95339cff642130c7fc1873337bbcb30c06cc3.jpg

BloodRayne: Terminal Cut Ultimate Update
Rayne’s debut game has gotten even better. This patch includes many updates that fans have been asking for such as mutants with their proper flesh color! 

Update Features


 Textures on enemy models have been restored to their original console version aesthetic
 Japanese voice-acting and subtitles have been added
 Additional rendering improvements to water and other textures
 Miscellaneous bug fixes


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373510

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/9ebe87a3a17926bbe6fc1ca3afb6da1e3ce226c6.jpg

BloodRayne 2: Terminal Cut Ultimate Update
Rayne returns to her updated second adventure. In addition to language and sound improvements, this patch introduces a rebalanced boss fight with Ephemera in the Twisted Garden to better match the experience players remember from the console version.

Update Features

 Ephemera boss fight rebalanced
 Restoration of missing music and audio tracks
 Improved graphical fidelity for bonus materials
 Russian language localization improvements
 Miscellaneous bug fixes


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373550

notes.title: Time for Heroics! Real Heroes: Firefighter HD launches today!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/a720b108b755b4fddadb59e042bc3dfc0ef77918.png

Charging headfirst into danger is just part of the job description.

In this first-person fire & rescue action game, players take on the heroic role of a real firefighter. As a newly graduated cadet starting out at a big city fire station in Los Angeles, the "powder keg" of the world, learn the tools of the trade, and battle massive fires and rescue survivors. So, put on a fresh pair of turnout pants and grab your Halligan. Live the life of one of the world's last true heroes – a real firefighter!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/2fd793219c0d6227a89140648d47d800090fd572.jpg

Features

 Realistic fire technology
 Play through career mode with over 9 levels and locations.
 Fight through the fires using real tools; Hose, Axe, Mechanical Separator, Extinguisher, Halligan, Deck Gun, and more.
 All-Star Hollywood voice cast including James Marsters (Buffy), Jack McGee (Rescue Me), Michael Jace (The Shield), Jamie Kennedy (Ghost Whisperer), and Jenette Goldstein (Aliens).


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36750418/0a22d1a3fbfd1edbfbaa46d4dd2d097349725df7.jpg

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content: We've released patch 1.03 for BloodRayne: Terminal Cut, which improves the playback of pre-rendered cutscenes, cinematics, and intro logos. If you are still experiencing screen flicker during cutscene playback or any other issues that may be specific to your system after this patch is applied, please send us a support request at support@zigguratinteractive.com. We have more fixes and updates for both Terminal Cut games in the works based on the feedback we’ve received, so stay tuned for further updates!
